facts.value: Students may meet any one or a combination of the following options, provided that three distinct laboratory-based science courses are completed with a 2.00 unweighted GPA or higher.

source.title: Laboratory science competency requirement

facts.value: Three years of high school laboratory sciences in three different subject areas, preferably biology, chemistry, earth science or physics.

source.title: Laboratory science competency requirement

facts.value: A laboratory-based integrated science course may be allowed to substitute for one of the three lab sciences. Each course should be one year in length.

source.title: Laboratory science competency requirement

facts.value: Additionally, a laboratory-based advanced science course may be allowed to substitute for one of the three lab sciences.

source.title: Laboratory science competency requirement

facts.value: An advanced science class is a lab science that is generally taken in the last two years of high school and is at least one of the following: an advanced placement course, a higher-level international baccalaureate course, a dual enrollment course, other honors course for which the previous lab science course is a prerequisite.
